text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the night before the JBC Classic, and
I've
finished making all my preparations.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute and I decide to watch a
rousing
boxing movie together.

text_block_list.name: Old Boxer
text_block_list.text:
Don't think you can take me just 'cause
I've gone
a little gray! Come at me,
boyo!

text_block_list.name: Old Boxer
text_block_list.text:
Don't you know a fire always burns
hottest right
before it goes out? Take
your best shot!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohhhhh. That's what I'm talking about!
Did you
see that? Is he cool or what?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute is fully engrossed in the
movie.
This might be my chance...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Hey, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: One, two! One, two! Swish!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her hands are balled into fists, and she's

shadowboxing as she watches like an
excited
child. If she's this relaxed, I
guess there's nothing
to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtains rise on a race across

generations—one pitting us against
Hokko
Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Deep breaths... Deep breaths...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, Tarumae dear? Are you
nervous?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Acute! I'm really looking forward to
racing
you...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As am I, dearie. Before we can do that,
though,
I'm going to need you to take a
deep breath.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This is our big chance to race each other.
It'd be a
shame to have you all stiff with
nerves.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. I just need to calm
down... and
tell you...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm coming after you with everything I've
got
today!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, is that right? Well then, that
means I'll
have to show you what I've got
too...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As well as the spark that I inherited from
Falco.
Make sure you take a good look,
you hear?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I will!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Very good, dear. Then, I'll see you out
on the
track.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and Tarumae, sweetie. One more
thing. I
know we are the dearest of
friends, but do not
take me lightly
today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you do, I'm afraid you'll be left with
quite the
nasty burn... Understood?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
O-of course... I've never taken you
lightly, and I
never will.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And you're not the only one coming in
hot today!
In fact, this is the most fired
up I've been all year!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that right? I'm glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute performed her role as a
more
experienced racer well... but
there's nothing
lacking in her
competitiveness today either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what this race against the
younger
runners will bring out of
Wonder Acute.
